conventions: Entreaty particle אָנָּא before a vocative divine name: where the ASV writes the full formula 'I beseech thee' the particle takes it (rule 30) and a supplied 'O' before the name is the vocative's (rule 36), as in PSA.116.4; where the ASV writes only 'O Jehovah', the single 'O' is what it spends on the particle and goes to אָנָּא under rule 11, the name taking only 'Jehovah'. Count the ASV's words against the two morphemes as rule 36 counts a supplied 'ye'. Competing reading (O to the name, particle unrepresented) is named in the unit note.

נֶגְדָה־נָּא לְכָל־עַמּוֹ → 'Yea, in the presence of all his people' (also PSA.116.18): נֶגְדָה with its directive he (Sd) fuses into the one compound 'in the presence' headed on 'presence' (rules 30, 32); the particle נָא takes the 'Yea' the ASV writes for it rather than leaving it added; the לְ takes 'of' as the relation the ASV writes for it.
report: Read all 19 verses end to end against the candidate table and the dump; every difference the table flags is licensed by what the ASV wrote, and no construction is analysed two ways.

לְ: 116.7 לִמְנוּחָיְכִי → unto and 116.2 לִי → unto me are rendered prepositions; 116.6 לִי → 'saved me' and 116.16 לְמוֹסֵרָי → 'loosed my bonds' are datives the ASV recasts as bare objects and are unrepresented under rule 40. Not a split.

קָרָא: 116.2 'will I call', 116.13 'call' (auxiliary written once over the coordinated verbs 'I will take ... And call'), 116.17 'will call' (ASV rewrites the auxiliary). Each verb holds exactly what the ASV wrote beside it.
הַ: 116.11 כָּל־הָאָדָם → 'All men' leaves the article unrepresented (no 'the' written); 116.15 הַמָּוְתָה → 'the death' takes it. Rule 29 in both.

אָנָּא: 116.4 'O Jehovah, I beseech thee' gives the formula to the particle and the O to the vocative name; 116.16 'O Jehovah' gives the single O to the particle and leaves the name bare. Two English words answer to two morphemes in each verse, so the difference is the ASV's and not a split; recorded as a convention since a later reader would otherwise rediscover it, and the competing reading is named in the 116.16 note.
Added units (116.1 'and', 116.2 'upon him', 116.8 'And') are all supplied connectives/objects with no morpheme in the clause; no verse folds a comparable word into a neighbour.
116.2 noncompositional בְיָמַי → 'as long as I live' is genuinely unallocatable and its note names the competing split.

BSB disagreements (two Sh he's, two silenced dative לְ's, the article of כָּל־הָאָדָם) are the documented convention differences of rules 32, 40 and 29; none is an error. No promotions: the chapter teaches nothing the contract does not already carry.
